name: Georgina te Heuheu
story: As Courts Minister, Georgina te Heuheu officially launched the Māori Land Court GIS Project on 4 March 2011. The release documents the portal’s geospatial Māori land information, public search and download functions, te reo Māori view and use of Google technology with LINZ information.
